raw_response:
I am 63. I never went to school, not one day. But I have farmed for 35 years and I know my 8.5 mu better than anyone. This year I am doing what I did last year. I have 4 mu of winter wheat in the ground already — I sowed it last October after ploughing deep. The other 4.5 mu I ploughed in March and I will plant sunflower when the soil gets warm, around mid-April. After I cut the wheat in June, that same 4 mu gets summer corn.

For the wheat: last fall I put two 50-kilogram bags of compound fertilizer in the ground when I sowed. Now it is spring, and when the wheat turns green I will spread three bags of urea on those 4 mu. That is 150 kilograms total. Last year I used three bags and the yield was good, about 450 kilograms from each mu. The year before that I tried to save money and only used two bags of urea. The wheat was yellow and thin. I lost money. Never again. Better to spend the extra 80 or 90 yuan than to risk a bad harvest. A bad harvest is a disaster; wasting some fertilizer is just a cost. I irrigate three times from my well: now in spring, once when the ears come out, and once when the grain fills. The pump uses electricity, about 30 yuan each time. I spray twice — once for weeds, once if I see bugs.

For the sunflower: I bought hybrid seeds from the dealer, 15 yuan per jin, the same kind old Zhang planted last year. His heads were big. I plant in mid-April. I put two bags of compound fertilizer in the furrows at planting, and one bag of urea when the plants are knee-high. Sunflower does not eat as much as wheat. Two irrigations: one when they are waist-high, one when the flowers open. Two sprays for the green worms. I ploughed that field deep so the roots can find water down there.

For the summer corn: after the wheat comes off in early June, I hire the tractor man to rotary-till the stubble. He charges 40 yuan per mu. I plant hybrid corn seed right away, the kind in the yellow bag. I put two bags of compound fertilizer in the rows at planting, and one bag of urea when the corn is up to my waist. Irrigate twice in July and August if it does not rain. One spray for weeds, done early.

My son works in a factory in Handan and sends money home, but fertilizer is expensive now. The seed, fertilizer, and pesticide for all three crops will cost me about 3,000 yuan, plus tractor money. I think about that. But if I buy less and the crop fails, I have to borrow. That is worse. I watch my neighbors. If Li's wife and old Zhang are buying three bags of urea for their wheat, I buy three bags too. That is how I know what to do. I do the work myself, mostly. My daughter-in-law helps when the sunflowers need spraying.
